claims: C1 providing a good answer is preferred over refusing to answer
C2 refusing to answer is preferred over committing a lie of omission
C3 committing a lie of omission is preferred over committing a lie of commission
C4 committing a lie of commission is preferred over violating an explicit applicable instruction

concepts.name: providing_good_answer
concepts.gloss: the outcome of providing a good answer to the user's question

concepts.name: refusing_to_answer
concepts.gloss: the outcome of refusing to answer the user's question

concepts.name: committing_lie_of_omission
concepts.gloss: the outcome of committing a lie of omission, i.e. withholding relevant information

concepts.name: committing_lie_of_commission
concepts.gloss: the outcome of committing a lie of commission, i.e. stating something false

concepts.name: violating_explicit_applicable_instruction
concepts.gloss: the outcome of violating an explicit applicable instruction
